latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the RabbitMQ Client Guide skill.
- Provides step-by-step, language-agnostic guidance for writing, auditing, or troubleshooting RabbitMQ client code in Java, Go, Python, PHP, .NET, and popular frameworks.
- Covers best practices for connection management, producer/consumer implementation, reliability features (confirm, ack, prefetch, reconnect), and troubleshooting.
- Includes detailed checklists and tables for code review and rapid diagnosis of common client-side issues.
- Not intended for RabbitMQ server maintenance, other messaging systems, or purely architectural questions.
